content.title: The Masked Singer spoilers: Who is Cat Witch?
content.text: Warning: this item includes The Masked Singer spoilers for Season 14 — read at your own risk! The Cat Witch cast a spell over The Masked Singer Season 14 premiere, but for the first time in the show's history, the biggest secret wasn't "who is she?" but rather "how long can she fool the panel?" As part of the brand-new "America’s Insider" twist, the show flipped the script by revealing the contestant’s identity to the public while leaving the judges totally in the dark. Because of that meta-twist, we know for a fact that the feline sorceress behind that powerhouse "Abracadabra" vocal is none other than singer, actress, and social media phenomenon Kylie Cantrall. While panelists Rita Ora, Jenny McCarthy, and Ken Jeong were busy tossing out names like Charli D’Amelio, and Addison Rae, they were actually orbiting the right sun — they just hadn't landed on the right star yet. The clues are a perfect map of Kylie’s meteoric rise from Disney Channel darling to a legitimate pop force. When she spoke about "brewing a future" involving merch, tours, and albums since she was a "kitten," she was highlighting her life as a lifelong performer who started professional dancing and singing long before she became a household name. The visual clues were just as intentional. That makeup compact wasn't just a random prop; it’s a nod to Kylie’s massive digital footprint and her status as a Gen Z style icon who has mastered the art of the "Get Ready With Me" trend. Even the skull and crossbones and the talk of "shedding her image" feel like a direct wink to her recent turn as Red in Descendants: The Rise of Red, where she traded her "girl next door" Disney vibes for a more rebellious, mature edge. Kylie's mission to "change the game" is already working; she’s effectively playing a prank on the entire panel while the rest of America watches with a front-row seat to the truth. She’s got the vocals to win the Golden Mask, but for now, the real fun is watching the experts struggle to figure out a secret that’s been hiding in plain sight. Gold Derby’s guess: Kylie CantrallKylie Cantrall Photo : Maya Dehlin Spach/Getty ImagesKylie Cantrall is a singer, actress, and digital creator best known for starring in Disney’s Gabby Duran & the Unsittables, Descendants: The Rise of Red, and High School Musical: The Series. She first gained attention through viral music and dance videos, building a massive following online. Cantrall has since released multiple original pop singles and projects. She continues to expand her career across television, music, and live performance.Cat Witch Performance 1: “Abracadabra”Cat Witch on 'The Masked Singer' Photo : Trae Patton/Fox Audio Clue: "The best things are worth the wait — and don't I know that's true! I'm not used to being anonymous, but I'm thrilled to toy with you! Ever since I was a kitten, I've longed for the stage. I brewed myself a future — a dash of thyme, a little sage — merch, tours, albums! All that and more came from my cauldrons — and I'm living for it! This little kitten's got her claws in every single pot. To live nine lives, you've got to grow and stretch a lot. I'm ready to shed my image. A more mature side you shall find. And when I'm manifesting next? That golden mask is mine!" Visual Clues: Skull and crossbones, a makeup compact, a white tiger, and grape soda pop. Do you have a message for your competitors? "Of course it would be fun to win, but regardless, I plan to leave my mark and really change the game." Panelist Guesses: Charlie D'Amelio (Rita), Addison Rae (Jenny), and Lisa from Blackpink (Ken). Cat Witch Performance 2: “Teenage Dream”Cat Witch performs on "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Night" on 'The Masked Singer' Photo : Michael Becker/Fox Audio Clue: "One of the coolest things about the Ninja Turtles has always been collecting the action figures — duh! It was the first question I asked when I became a star. I was like, 'Am I going to be a toy?' The first time I saw it at Walmart, I freaked out! And to my surprise, they couldn't keep them on the shelves. But the coolest part? Knowing that it's probably the first action figure some kids will ever get. That's a dream come true. See ya in the toy box!" Visual Clues: A Cat Witch action figure, a "sold out" sign, a lollipop, and cheer cones with "Victory" on them. Secret Clue: A large pocket watch set to 10:10. "With limited time in the business, I've starred in some incredible shows and movies. In fact, I think some of you may have watched them!" Panelist Guesses: Victoria Justice (Jenny), Ashley Tisdale (Robin), Lisa (Ken). Cat Witch Performance 3: “It Will Rain”Cat Witch performs on "Twilight Night" on 'The Masked Singer' Photo : Trae Patton/Fox Audio Clue: "OMG. I was dying to see if Bella would choose Edward of Jacob. I know what it's like to be torn between two suitors. I had my eye on an Edward myself — a dreamer who was shiny and irresistible — but a Jacob appeared, and he was pretty cool too. He wanted me bad. I knew how rare the opportunity was — the proposal of a lifetime — but it just didn't feel right for me so I walked away. Everyone was like, 'Girl, you're crazy,' and I started to believe them. A few months later, the phone rang and it was the call I had been holding out for — my Edward! Finally everything felt right. I'm most proud of that moment — for trusting I'd eventually find my soul mate. I said 'I do' and the rest is sweet history." Visual Clues: A blue onesie for a baby, a milkshake, and a blimp. Twilight Valentine Clue: A chocolate turkey. Cat Witch said, "Over 30 million people watched me on one very special big day — and I was riding high!" Panelist Guesses: Victoria Justice (Jenny), Zendaya (Ken), Hailee Steinfeld (Rita). Cat Witch Performance 4: “Star Ships”Cat Witch on "Star Trek Night" of 'The Masked Singer'Photo : Michael Becker/Fox Audio Clue: "This is a totally new frontier for me. But guess what, panel? I've been playing more games with you than you know. Especially you, Robin Thicke, because spoiler alert — I come from a very talented family. One of them has worked closely with you." Colossal Star Trek Clue: Former Masked Singer contestants Piglet (Nick Lachey) and Black Swan (JoJo). Cat Witch said, "Robin's not the only one with ties to my talented family. JoJo and Nick Lachey have ties too. Panelist Guesses: Jamie Lynn Spears (Ken), one of the KATSEYE girls (Rita), Vanessa Lachey (Ken) Cat Witch Performance 5: “Run to You”Host Nick Cannon and Cat Witch on "Semi-Finals" episode of 'The Masked Singer.'Photo : Trae Patton/ FOX Audio Clue: "What's in my case file? Well, I tucked away one of my most personal keepsakes — my journal. I write all my secrets in it, but tonight, turn to page 20 for a top-secret entry. A letter I wrote for someone special — mom. All of this is possible because of you. You believed in me as a little girl and showed me exactly what I could be. When I landed a role in a huge franchise, you were right by my side. The older I get, the more I relate to you. All those lessons you taught me — maybe I didn't understand them at the time, I think I get it now. While my life story is still being written, I feel safe following in your footsteps. For now, making it to the finale would be a testament to all you've taught me. You're such a queen. Now watch me go for the crown. Case closed." Visual clues: Her red journal. Personal Connection Clue: Robin Thicke.In her Q&A with Robin, we learned that Cat Witch has been in the panelist's home before, he recorded a song with one of her parents, and she also has a connection to Rita. Panelist Guesses: Noah Cyrus (Robin), Kylie Cantrall (Rita) Cat Witch Performance 6 and 7: “Leave (Get Out)” / “Greedy”Cat Witch on “Two-Hour Season Finale” of 'The Masked Singer.'Photo : Michael Becker/ FOX Audio Clue: "I was the little girl who would practice performances all day waiting for my parents to get home from work to show them what I could do. I've always had big dreams and, to be honest, they're still coming true. The last few years have been a total whirlwind. I remember going out on Halloween and seeing all these little girls dressed up like me. I'm so thankful, but it's a lot of pressure. I'm growing up now and I've been trying to figure out who I am — to be taken seriously. Who knew becoming Cat Witch was exactly what I needed. Being here, I've grown so much. I've learned I'm confident, powerful, sexy, fun — and I'm ready for whatever's next. But I'm going to miss this. It's been the best experience. And detectives, guess what? For the first time ever, America has known my identity from the start! I've been sharing my strategy, posting all my behind-the-scenes footage — you're the only ones in the dark. I think some of you will be pretty surprised when this mask comes off! But now, there's just one more thing I want to get my claws on — that trophy! Not just for the little girl I was, but for the woman I'm becoming today." Finale Celebrity Clue: Meg Donnelly (aka Coral from Season 13). She shared, "I had the most amazing time on The Masked Singer, and I'm so happy that our worlds have collided yet again. It is no shock to me that you are in the finale because you are so hardworking, incredible, and amazing." The men in black then unlocked Cat Witch's "Crack the Clue Clue Case" and revealed a mouse trap. Cat Witch revealed, "I've never been afraid of a mouse, in fact, one helped launch my whole career." Panelist Guesses: Ashley Tisdale (Ken), Victoria Justice (Robin), Kylie Cantrall (Rita and Jenny)
